command: node benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/record-memory-project-id.mjs --tree <git archive of b6f10295a2f698afc85332467192de28500bd146 with node_modules>

entry.notRun: resolveProjectScope (explicit session cwd): no case of the test file
entry.runs: resolveProjectId (project-id-resolver.mjs) on a real directory tree per case, built on disk from the case's `layout` (directories and marker files with their bytes), resolved from `cwd`

normalised.paths: the root of each tree is a temp directory; the recording holds the layout and cwd relative to it

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay: mixdog-services memory/project.rs resolve_project_id, which reads .mixdog/project.id through the cwd's ancestors on disk. The replay (memory/replays/project_id.rs) builds each case's directory tree from the recorded `layout` under a fresh temp root, in order, resolves from the recorded `cwd` and compares the result whole; it checks that no marker lies above the temp root, as on the recording PC
timezone: UTC (process.env.TZ set by lib/mc-record.mjs before any date formatting: local-time text in a recording is UTC)
